categories.name: Developer Tools
categories.description: MCP servers for everyday coding work: repositories, code search, issues, API tooling and your local files, reachable from your AI assistant.

categories.name: Docs & Knowledge
categories.description: Servers that put current documentation and knowledge bases into the model's context, so answers come from the real source instead of memory.

categories.name: Search & Web Data
categories.description: Web search, crawling, scraping and extraction servers that let an assistant read the live web.

categories.name: Browser Automation
categories.description: Drive a real browser from your assistant: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots and run end-to-end checks.

categories.name: Databases & Backend
categories.description: Query and manage SQL and NoSQL databases, backend platforms and data warehouses in plain language.

categories.name: Cloud & DevOps
categories.description: Deploy and operate infrastructure: hosting platforms, containers, Kubernetes, DNS and CI/CD.

categories.name: Observability & Incidents
categories.description: Errors, logs, traces and on-call. Let the assistant investigate an incident with real production data.

categories.name: Productivity & Projects
categories.description: Docs, project trackers, tasks and files: create tickets, update pages and search your workspace.

categories.name: Communication & Meetings
categories.description: Chat, email, meetings and transcripts your assistant can read from and post to.

categories.name: Design, Websites & CMS
categories.description: Design files, diagrams, site builders and content management systems, from Figma frames to published pages.

categories.name: Finance & Payments
categories.description: Payments, invoicing, spend management and banking data exposed as MCP tools.

categories.name: CRM, Sales & Support
categories.description: CRMs, prospecting and support desks: look up accounts, log activity and answer tickets.

categories.name: Marketing & SEO
categories.description: Email and SMS marketing, SEO data and ad platforms for growth teams.

categories.name: Data & Analytics
categories.description: Product analytics and BI tools you can question in natural language.

categories.name: AI & Machine Learning
categories.description: Model hubs, datasets, memory and reasoning helpers for AI work.

categories.name: Security & Compliance
categories.description: Code scanning, dependency checks, secrets and compliance tooling.

categories.name: Automation & Integrations
categories.description: Workflow platforms that connect hundreds of apps through a single MCP endpoint.

categories.name: Travel & Maps
categories.description: Flights, hotels, places and routes: plan trips and answer location questions.

categories.name: E-commerce
categories.description: Storefronts, catalogs, orders and fulfilment for online shops.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Small, focused servers: time, maths, conversions, test data and other handy helpers.
